url.description: Original input URL or bare domain requested for auditing.

normalizedInputUrl.description: Normalized HTTP/HTTPS URL derived from input.

finalUrl.description: Resolved homepage URL after validated HTTP redirects.

status.description: Audit execution status (audited, blocked_ssrf, blocked_robots, error).

sitePlatform.description: Detected storefront or web platform (shopify, woocommerce, bigcommerce, magento, wix, squarespace, saas-web, custom).

businessModel.description: Classified subscription model (dtc_ecommerce_subscription, b2b_or_b2c_saas, membership_or_media, non_subscription).

subscriptionStack.description: Detected DTC subscription apps and SaaS billing engines (recharge, skio, loop-subscriptions, bold-subscriptions, ordergroove, stay-ai, seal-subscriptions, appstle, stripe-billing, chargebee, recurly, paddle, zuora, lemon-squeezy).

hasSubscriptionSignals.description: Whether recurring subscription, membership, auto-delivery, or free-trial offers were detected.

loadTimeMs.description: Total site audit duration in milliseconds.

pagesFetchedCount.description: Total HTTP pages fetched for this site (homepage + discovered internal pricing/terms/cancel subpages).

pagesFetched.description: URLs of all pages inspected on this site.

errorMessage.description: Diagnostic error or security block reason when status is not audited.

complianceScore.description: Deterministic 0-100 US subscription & ARL technical compliance score (100 = no heuristic issues detected).

riskTier.description: Heuristic compliance risk tier: CRITICAL, HIGH, MODERATE, or LOW.

cancellationStatus.description: Click-to-Cancel classification (online_self_serve_found, call_or_email_obstruction, survey_gated, no_cancel_mechanism_disclosed, no_subscription_detected, not_checked).

onlineClickToCancelFound.description: Whether an unobstructed online self-serve Click-to-Cancel mechanism or portal was detected.

callOrEmailObstructionFound.description: Whether phone-only, email-only, or live-chat-agent cancellation obstructions were detected.

mandatoryExitSurveyFound.description: Whether mandatory exit-survey fields or questionnaire gates were detected on cancellation flows (NYC Oct 2026 Rule / CA AB 2863).

clickToCancelCheck.description: Detailed Click-to-Cancel, obstruction, and exit-survey analysis.

preCheckedConsentBoxFound.description: Whether a pre-checked recurring/auto-renewal consent checkbox (<input type=checkbox checked>) was detected.

missingAutoRenewalDisclosure.description: Whether subscription offers lacked explicit continuous auto-renewal disclosure text.

missingTrialConversionDisclosure.description: Whether a free-trial offer lacked clear post-trial recurring price and cancellation deadline wording.

affirmativeConsentCheck.description: Detailed CA AB 2863 / ROSCA affirmative consent & free-trial conversion analysis.

dripFeeViolationFound.description: Whether mandatory service, processing, or convenience drip fees disclosed outside upfront prices were detected (CA SB 478).

dripFeeCheck.description: Detailed California SB 478 Honest Pricing / drip-fee analysis.

pricingUrl.description: Discovered Pricing / Plans / Subscribe subpage URL.

cancelPageUrl.description: Discovered Cancellation / Manage Subscription portal URL.

termsUrl.description: Discovered Terms of Service / Terms & Conditions URL.

billingOrFaqUrl.description: Discovered Billing / FAQ / Refund Policy URL.

discoveredLinks.description: Structured subscription, pricing, cancellation, and legal URLs discovered on the site.

findingsCount.description: Total number of compliance findings flagged.

findings.description: Prioritized technical compliance findings with ruleId, regulation, severity, evidence, and recommendation.

coldOutreachHook.description: Neutral, factual 1-2 sentence B2B outreach observation ready for Clay, n8n, Smartlead, or Instantly.

remediationPackGenerated.description: Whether a CA AB 2863 / CO SB 25-145 HTML/JS consent + 1-click cancel remediation pack was generated.

remediationPack.description: Copy-pasteable Unchecked Express Auto-Renewal Consent Box + 1-Click Online Cancellation Modal HTML/JS snippets.

recommendedNextActors.description: Recommended follow-up Apify Actors (WCAG/ADA Visual Auditor & EU Withdrawal/Omnibus Auditor).
